notes.title: Reflections on 2024
notes.content:
A lot happened in the past year. Many felt the impact of escalating geopolitical events, and I am personally somewhat anxious about my own wellbeing in the coming year. There is a space for games that speak to these issues, but RSOD is primarily a low-brow action game, so I will leave the political discussion at that.

For RSOD, the single most important milestone in 2024 was [url=https://code.onedev.io/RSOD]the release of its source code[/url] under a permissive license. Since June, the Git commit log has tracked every change to the engine, including:

[list]
[*]Projectile Weapons (Plasma Pup and enemy shotgun)
[*]Game maps as title screen backgrounds
[*]Continuous particle emitters (smoke barrels and rain)
[*]Improvements to UI, enemy AI, and bug fixes
[/list]
[h3]New Map: Hidden Valley[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41570668/a6c452b6c2a9bf4587bb766522fd84b76d68e0bc.jpg[/img]
This is a work in progress. Anyone who tries to make a game with cyberpunk aesthetics will quickly come to the realization that the world we live in is quite cyberpunk already, thus the map looks like a place you might see in your town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41570668/9d041617ef308fdb986205bc9f7e28b2814a93d1.jpg[/img]
I'm proud of the architectural detail, which comes from that liminal space between minimalism and brutalism you see in a mid-90s FPS. This is a mid-2020s FPS, so I'd call it [i]nostalgic[/i].

The demo has been updated with all of these changes and more, so please give it a shot! Have a happy new year.

notes.title: Progress Report: 2023/09/02
notes.content:
[h2]THE BASICS[/h2]

In the past month, I added three significant quality-of-life features to RSOD:

[list]
[*] Saving and loading
[*] Options menu
[*] Radar minimap
[/list]

It's no coincidence that I received this comment in a survey:

[quote]Have the possibility to change the controls for the qwerty keyboard.[/quote]

Well, anonymous playtester, check it out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41570668/7508e3d8b7e5219787bfa40c900bb6b39d7bba5e.png[/img]

Note that the game starts with default keybindings based on your keyboard layout, so if you have an AZERTY keyboard you will automatically have ZQSD rather than WASD, and this is reflected in the options menu.

[h2]HIATUS[/h2]

A typical FPS has more than 50 maps. RSOD currently has 8, so let's call it 16% complete. At this rate, the game will be finished in early 2034.

I intended the game's story to be a loud warning to Big Tech, but at present the experience feels a bit generic. Steam can't tell it apart from one of those glitchy Unity games with 1000 zombies that let you move around after you're dead (not as a zombie). For these reasons, I am putting the game on hiatus until it organically gets more wishlists.

The engine may still get updates as I prototype a dark fantasy game. (Send your ideas and other thoughts to support@microsm.space)

notes.title: Progress Report: 2023/04/01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41570668/9cd1bf0e1607dfcda880691c621866719383641c.gif[/img]

When I started writing this devlog in mid-March, I began with a list of features I had added since the previous devlog. There are performance optimizations, new content, and by far the biggest feature: a yet-unreleased VR mode.

I also saw this as a good day for a stunt post, it being April 1st. I considered a tryhard unfunny rap, but I ended up deciding that it was so tryhard and so unfunny that it would overshadow any ironic comedic value with genuine shame. I also considered posting a manifesto on the microscopic niche of Linux VR, but the manifesto ended up as a series of how-to guides that I am incrementally posting to Reddit. Therefore, rather than pleading in a chapter-length devlog for the reader to take interest, I give you a list of important changes since March 1st:

[list]
[*] Added more buildings
[*] Lighting and performance tweaks
[*] Dynamic resolution scaling
[*] Added remotely operated doors
[*] Added the first melee weapon
[*] Improved text layout for character dialogue
[*] Started pitching this as an adult-oriented game
[*] Misc. content tweaks
[*] Misc. bug fixes
[/list]

I would post more GIFs and more text, but nobody can be bothered to engage with this content beyond a superficial level right now, so I'll leave it here. March was a productive month!

notes.title: Progress Report: 2023/01/01
notes.content:
I originally planned to release RSOD in early 2023, but now it's looking like a "when it's done" release schedule. Thanks for all the feedback you have given on the playtest, which will remain open until the first demo is released. I can't say when that is, but perhaps this year.

I know my fellow millennials like pictures between the words, so here's a before-and-after screenshot comparison:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41570668/3e58fe517a4dfeeb484b6fa492f465a298ffa595.jpg[/img]

You can see the addition of a HUD, vehicle headlights, clouds, more environment details, new shaders, and of course weapons.

Now, let me set the stage with a few words about scope, themes, and tone.

[h2]Scope[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41570668/50a3a024e4ac534a322e44002a9af17a848988af.jpg[/img]

RSOD is a single-player open-world FPSRPG with a story. If the feature you want isn't in that sentence, it probably won't be in the game. Think Borderlands, Half-Life, and Ion Fury.

[h2]Themes and Tone[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41570668/2a5f4f27677dc19d62d60f4b5bc428b6f8e215f0.jpg[/img]

Almost nobody does cyberpunk just right. The way I imagine it, it's about hacking and killing for money, but mainly it's about sex. I want to create an amoral world where the player does whatever pleases him, her, or it (within the limitations of the software). A world that is fully adult in its humor and storytelling.

In my opinion, the best cyberpunk atmosphere of any game can be found in Dex, and its original creator died several years ago, so it's too late to tell him that. Dex is brightly lit and slightly futuristic, not the total grunge misery of Deus Ex and "dystopian" cyberpunk. I don't want to make something dystopian, I want to make something that gets you amped up at any time of the night to go do some fucked up shit.

I hope you understand that this isn't GTA and it's not made for teenagers. If you are intelligent and you enjoy the combination of serious topics and kinetic violence, this might be for you.
